title: Cosmic Instacart Delivery
description: Three women with green, purple, and golden skin stand in profile gazing right, adorned with ornate headwraps and patterns. A drone carrying four green Instacart grocery bags flies toward a large glowing Instacart billboard against a vibrant cosmic background filled with galaxies, nebulae, and glowing circular portals.
prompt: Three women in profile with green, purple, and golden skin wearing ornate patterned headwraps stand gazing right, a white delivery drone carrying four green Instacart grocery bags flies beside them toward a large glowing Instacart billboard, all set against a vibrant psychedelic cosmic background filled with swirling galaxies, colorful nebulae, glowing circular portals and ethereal energy waves in a surreal visionary style
